reviews.text:
I recently stayed here on a solo trip, and it truly exceeded all my expectations. The suite was huge, spotless, beautifully designed, and so cozy — everything felt fresh, modern, and relaxing. It had that “just right” balance of comfort and style that makes you feel at home away from home.

The customer service was outstanding! Everyone I interacted with was warm, friendly, and genuinely helpful — from the front desk to housekeeping. You can tell the staff takes real pride in making sure guests have a great experience.

The local restaurant was another highlight. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. My host and waitress were both so sweet and attentive, making dining solo feel comfortable and enjoyable.I put in my notes that I wanted a nice sunset view and they definitely made it happen!

Another huge plus — the location! The hotel is in walking distance to the Fashion Square Mall, Ocean 44, and Toca Madera, which made exploring and grabbing dinner super convenient.

Whether you’re traveling solo or just need a peaceful reset, this hotel is a total gem. I left feeling relaxed and recharged.

I would have loved to have given this an amazing review but unfortunately when I checked out, I left a dress in a garment bag in the closet and never saw it again. This was not a small item, nor something that could easily be missed by staff. I checked out on Sunday morning and realized I forgot it on Monday. I called explained the situation and gave them my room number and they just transferred me to security. Security didn't answer so I left a voicemail. I waited 24 hours and security never called back (we are in Tuesday now) so I called back and spoke to the front desk again. This time they contacted security on a walkie talkie to see if housekeeping logged it and took it to security. They replied that the do not have anything. They also contacted the housekeeping staff and they said they do not have it either. I was patched over to the manager where I left a message but have not received a call back. I am at a loss for words and do not trust this hotel. I mean I lost a dress but what if I had forgotten something ALOT more expensive. I do not think I trust the staff enough to stay at that hotel again. There is suppose to be protocol in place when guests leave something and it is logged and turned into security. It appears that this procedure was not followed

Also rated on Google someone said they would reach out to me… it’s been a few days no one has reached out nor has anyone called me back

reviews.text: The worst check in and front desk customer service EVER!!!! We finally decided to go there to see if we’re able to check in. A white male checked us is (i did not get his name but it was about 2pm on 5/25/25!) He told us that our room is still not ready — but he still gave us our room keys anyway— which was also odd. He did not even introduce us to the property, directions, etc. I was trying to tell him that we had been calling us all morning and no answer and he cuts me off saying they were busy. Mind you, I called the property while my husband was finishing the check in and phone does not ring at all. Everyday we were there, we would call concierge and housekeeping from our room and NO ANSWER. I call the Property from my cellphone and still no answer! And absolutely absurd!! until we checked out on 5/29/25, a differently lady was at check in she was a white female very friendly (unlike the previous ones) and I realized she had picked up the propertys phone. I thought, wow thats weird, now the phone is on. So i decided to call the Property from my cellphone and what do you know… she picks up. Phone not being on for 5 days is pretty damn wild.

reviews.text: Hilton has recently taken over this property and they have some work to do to get it into top operating condition. I booked the location because it was in a convenient location. It was priced at the upper range and so my expectations are high. I did note at the time that "service" had been dinged by other travelers and unfortunately, this is the case. The biggest problem is their breakfast cafe downstairs where 4 out of 5 days they goofed my breakfast order.  Housekeeping is also a bit sloppy and there was a Q-Tip sitting in the hallway for 2 days that the cleaning team just left behind. Strange: very easy to spot. So, while the location and facilities are great, Hilton has some work to do to tighten up the service on site. In the meantime, the room rates are high for the level of service provided. Knowing Hilton, they will get this fixed. It's just very disappointing to stay at a property that fails to deliver service.

reviews.title: SHAMEFUL!!
reviews.text: While the atmosphere was pleasant, my stay was not. The WiFi and AC did not work. Upon arrival, the room reserved was unavailable and we had to wait for another. We, then, were moved a second time due to AC and electrical problems. Though the manager was pleasant, the service beyond that point was terrible. She removed the amenity fees as a courtesy, at least we were told. The AC went out in the new room, and I was over it. The room was not cleaned all three nights and four days we were there. Just when I thought it couldn’t get worse, they attempted to finally come clean the room and kick us out prior to checkout time. After informing the front desk that the stay was terrible at checkout, they mentioned amenity fees, which I will be monitoring my card for. Will never be staying at this resort again.
